decisions.title: Get back the RM642 you paid twice
decisions.action: Ask Ladang Susu Segar Hulu Enterprise for a refund or credit note for invoice LSS/2609/278.
decisions.reason: Invoice LSS/2609/278 (RM642.00) left the bank twice, on 15 Sep (IBG0915S02) and 16 Sep (IBG0916S02). Your payables list shows it once. Paid twice; once is enough.
decisions.confidenceNote: Both bank lines and the invoice are in your files.

decisions.title: Serbuk Kopi O Campuran is up 12% in 8 invoices, with no notice
decisions.action: Ask Syarikat Kopi Cap Bintang Timur Sdn Bhd (S01) why Serbuk Kopi O Campuran rose from RM28.00 to RM31.36, and get two other quotes.
decisions.reason: RM28.00/kg on 17 Jun to RM31.36/kg on 23 Sep in three steps (+12%). Teh powder and robusta beans from the same supplier did not change, so this is item-specific. Extra paid so far RM147.62; about RM985 a year at 11.25 kg per order, 26 orders a year.

decisions.action: Ask your QR acquirer where the settlement for 18 Sep 2026 sales went.
decisions.reason: Your sales show RM312.40 of DuitNow QR on 18 Sep. Every other QR day settles the next day as DUITNOW QR MERCHANT SETTLEMENT; there is no line for 180926.
